method: Actual QuoteBuilder Review, completion/route-state components and pure calculation/display helpers in Chromium; sample records, action/router/other-step mocks. Browser policy blocks navigation, so supplied local HTML/CSS/JS rendered with set_content. No live Next/RSC/backend/device tests. Runtime reused from prior baseline fixture.

Primary uses current unsaved margins, then confirms, then existing customer route
Digital Review secondary uses identical preparation and Job Space route

Original non-draft lifecycle preserved: sent
Original non-draft lifecycle preserved: accepted

Original non-draft lifecycle preserved: archived

Review settings and step/back controls lock for the same submitted snapshot
No navigation until the existing confirmation action resolves

Review margins restores focus/draft and retries save without repeating successful confirmation

Preserved validation with explicit result: Item Cost=

Confirmation failure does not navigate; deliberate retry follows original idempotent action

Leaving during margins cancels client continuation, not completed server work
Leaving during confirm cancels client continuation, not completed server work
Known navigation rejection retries opening only; no repeated save/confirm
Navigation recovery can explicitly unlock review for more edits
